items.name: Readability
items.evidence: Small, clear edits. The nested .get('database', ...get('db', NAME)) follows the existing password/passwd chain. Keeping the local name `db` is a minor naming gap. The added tests are clearly named.

items.name: Maintainability
items.evidence: Minimal, local changes that reuse the existing fallback pattern. No helpers added, no dead code, no debug output. The new tests sit next to the related tests.

items.name: Robustness
items.evidence: Pure renames plus an extra fallback lookup. No new error paths, no exception swallowing, no magic constants. Old keys still work as fallbacks.

items.name: Connection kwargs use non-deprecated names
items.name_zh: 连接参数改用非弃用名称
items.evidence: base.py: kwargs['database'] = settings_dict['NAME'] and kwargs['password'] = settings_dict['PASSWORD']. No other changes to how kwargs are built.

items.name: Deprecated OPTIONS keys remain supported
items.name_zh: 弃用的 OPTIONS 键仍被兼容
items.evidence: client.py still falls back to OPTIONS 'db', then NAME. The password/passwd chain is unchanged. The OPTIONS passthrough in base.py is untouched. No version bump, no warnings.
